sources.scope: WCPO aggregated size/length data and metadata
sources.outcome: HTTP200; retained HTML. Download requires registration and no dataset link exposed. No account created or registration submitted. Relevant data exist, but their regional/gear sampling, units, coverage and mass fractions could not be inspected in this run.

Records are fish counts by length/weight class, gear, flag, fleet, time and spatial cell; schema is not a catch-mass share dataset. Would require sampling/raising checks and conversion before allocation.
Catch/effort data can support fleet weighting but does not establish caught-fish size fractions alone. Regional/year length data and consistent sampling expansion still required.

decision: No directly usable observed regional catch-mass fractions recovered after targeted primary-source search. Proceed with explicitly assumed historical model-catch proxy; preserve infant-missing/assumed-zero distinction and source/model limitations. This is not a claim that size data do not exist.
